name: Akatoki!! -Hana to Mawaseyo Koi no Ishou-
original_name: あかときっ!!-花と舞わせよ恋の衣装-
source:
This is the fandisk for Escu:de’s clothes shredding battle ADV title Akatoki!, featuring after stories for the 5 heroines as well as another stories for Miyu and Chikka. There is also a versus battle mode with rewards for winning. All the girls have new costumes, such as pajamas for Nayu and an idol outfit for Maki. Kukuriku also loses her clothes this time.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/05/18/may-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是Escu:de以爆衣战斗为卖点的ADV《Akatoki!》推出的Fandisc，收录5位女主角的后日谈，以及美优与琪卡的其他故事。
还设有对战模式，获胜即可得到奖励。
所有女孩都换上了新装，例如七夕的睡衣与真姬的偶像装；这次库库丽库也会被脱去衣物。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/05/18/may-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
